About Organization

The Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) is a government organization responsible for conducting various recruitment exams in the state of Uttar Pradesh.

The organization aims to provide employment opportunities to eligible candidates in various government departments.

About the Programme

The UPSSSC Forensic Science Laboratory Main Examination 2026 is a recruitment exam conducted by the Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) for various posts in the Forensic Science Laboratory.

The exam aims to select eligible candidates for the posts of Scientific Assistant, Scientific Assistant (Special Selection), Lab Assistant (Laboratory Assistant), and Lab Assistant (Special Selection).
